text:
Christopher Columbus.

And what a marvel of modern commerce it is to witness the sheer genius of "innovation" at work. Who needs genuine discovery or new ideas when you can simply take the exact same product, slap a new color on it, and charge more? It is truly breathtaking to see how companies have mastered the art of convincing us that our lives are incomplete without the same old thing, now dressed up in a sleek adjective. One must admire the audacity of this creative leap: transforming mediocrity into a premium experience simply by changing the label. It is not just business; it is a performance art piece on the gullibility of the consumer, proving that if you price it high enough and call it "new," people will buy it twice. Truly, the future of commerce is here, and it is just the past in a different shade.
